Take a picture of the shelf with your smartphone, and it will tell you what to do next—Retail AI "Pensa Actions AI"

Walking the sales floor to check shelves and finding out-of-stock items or incorrect shelf labels is an important task in retail, but it is time-consuming, requiring staff to scan barcodes for each product or visually verify promotional displays.

On November 3, 2026, Pensa Systems in the United States announced "Pensa Actions AI," an AI for retail staff. It uses cameras on devices like smartphones to check the sales floor, identify products that need restocking, find issues with shelf labels or promotional displays, and provide guidance by prioritizing the necessary tasks.
■ Proposing task order just by checking the shelves

Traditional shelf checks have relied on scanning products or price tags one by one with a barcode scanner. Pensa Actions AI is designed to use AI to analyze images of shelves and promotional areas, presenting the tasks that need to be addressed on the sales floor all at once.

For example, it identifies tasks such as restocking out-of-stock items, checking shelf labels, and correcting promotional displays, and guides the user through them like a route. Each suggestion is also accompanied by a reason.

It is designed to be used as a standalone smartphone app or as tasks within existing employee workflow management software. Supported devices include iPhones, Android smartphones, and professional scanners. On some newer devices, it is designed to process data locally even in stores with weak network connectivity.
